ms: Ms is a chronic progressive nervous disorder involving loss of myelin sheath around certain nerve fibers.
Ms can also mean a state in the Deep South on the gulf of Mexico.
Ms can also mean a master's degree in science.
Ms means the same as multiple sclerosis or disseminated sclerosis or disseminated multiple sclerosis.
ms-dos: MS-DOS is an operating system developed by Bill Gates for personal computers.
MS-DOS means the same as Microsoft disk operating system.
Ms. is a form of address for a woman.
Ms. means the same as Ms.
msasa: Msasa is small shrubby African tree having compound leaves and racemes of small fragrant green flowers.
Msasa means the same as Brachystegia speciformis.
msb: MSB is a state-chartered savings bank owned by its depositors and managed by a board of trustees.
MSB means the same as mutual savings bank.
msc: MSc is a master's degree in science.
MSc means the same as Master of Science or MS or SM.
msec: A msec is one thousandth of a second.
Msec means the same as millisecond.
msg: MSG is white crystalline compound used as a food additive to enhance flavor.
For example: "Food manufacturers sometimes list MSG simply as `artificial flavors' in ingredient lists."
MSG means the same as monosodium glutamate.
msh: MSH is a hormone secreted by the anterior pituitary gland that controls the degree of pigmentation in melanocytes.
MSH means the same as melanocyte-stimulating hormone.
mst: MST is standard time in the 7th time zone west of Greenwich, reckoned at the 105th meridian west.
MST means the same as Mountain Time or Mountain Standard Time.
